rule: A heatmap cell is stream-coverage eligible iff the server stamps has_contract_identity=true. That stamp is true iff vendor_option_root(call) or vendor_option_root(put) is non-empty (21-character OSI). The client consumes only that stamp; a missing or malformed stamp is ineligible. NO CONTRACT cells stay labelled and are excluded. ZERO OI cells with a validated OSI remain included.
client_rule: cellHasContractIdentity returns true only when stream[j].has_contract_identity === true. There is no client-side identity parser.
